entries.title: II Peter 1:1
segments: ¶Simon Peter, bondman and apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have received like precious faith with us through [the] righteousness of our God and Saviour Jesus Christ:

entries.title: II Peter 1:2
segments: Grace and peace be multiplied to you in [the] knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.

entries.title: II Peter 1:3
segments: As his divine power has given to us all things which relate to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that has called us by glory and virtue,

entries.title: II Peter 1:4
segments: through which he has given to us the greatest and precious promises, that through these ye may become partakers of [the] divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

entries.title: II Peter 1:5
segments: ¶But for this very reason also, using therewith all diligence, in your faith have also virtue, in virtue knowledge,

entries.title: II Peter 1:6
segments: in knowledge temperance, in temperance endurance, in endurance godliness,

entries.title: II Peter 1:7
segments: in godliness brotherly love, in brotherly love love:

entries.title: II Peter 1:8
segments: for these things existing and abounding in you make [you] to be neither idle nor unfruitful as regards the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ;

entries.title: II Peter 1:9
segments: for he with whom these things are not present is blind, short-sighted, and has forgotten the purging of his former sins.

entries.title: II Peter 1:10
segments: Wherefore the rather, brethren, use diligence to make your calling and election sure, for doing these things ye will never fall;

entries.title: II Peter 1:11
segments: for thus shall the entrance into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ be richly furnished unto you.

entries.title: II Peter 1:12
segments: ¶Wherefore I will be careful to put you always in mind of these things, although knowing [them] and established in the present truth.

entries.title: II Peter 1:13
segments: But I account it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting [you] in remembrance,

entries.title: II Peter 1:14
segments: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle is speedily [to take place], as also our Lord Jesus Christ has manifested to me;

entries.title: II Peter 1:15
segments: but I will use diligence, that after my departure ye should have also, at any time, [in your power] to call to mind these things.

entries.title: II Peter 1:16
segments: ¶For we have not made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, following cleverly imagined fables, but having been eyewitnesses of *his* majesty.

entries.title: II Peter 1:17
segments: For he received from God [the] Father honour and glory, such a voice being uttered to him by the excellent glory: This is my beloved Son, in whom *I* have found my delight;

entries.title: II Peter 1:18
segments: and this voice *we* heard uttered from heaven, being with him on the holy mountain.

entries.title: II Peter 1:19
segments: ¶And we have the prophetic word [made] surer, to which ye do well taking heed (as to a lamp shining in an obscure place) until [the] day dawn and [the] morning star arise in your hearts;

entries.title: II Peter 1:20
segments: knowing this first, that [the scope of] no prophecy of scripture is had from its own particular interpretation,

entries.title: II Peter 1:21
segments: for prophecy was not ever uttered by [the] will of man, but holy men of God spake under the power of [the] Holy Spirit.
